guidance.bestFor: Every variant prop left at its default, giving an outline surface at style radius around a folder glyph

whenNotToUse.when: A surface lifted off the page by a muted fill, a ring and a shadow

guidance.bestFor: A lone raised chip with a muted fill, a page colored ring and a soft shadow, around a package glyph

whenNotToUse.when: A flat bordered surface quiet enough for dense rows and toolbars

guidance.bestFor: A muted outer ring around an inset card, the double surface that echoes the Frame primitive, around a dashboard glyph

whenNotToUse.when: A nested surface that takes its color tone from one text class

guidance.bestFor: The 5 surface treatments in one row around the same package glyph, for comparing them before picking one
Elevated tiles at xs, sm, default, lg and xl, bottom aligned so box and glyph growth compare step by step
Large round tiles in the outline, elevated and nested card surfaces, with globe, star and check glyphs
Resizing outside the size prop 2 ways, size classes on tile and glyph or both size variables in one class
agentNotes: `size-14` on the tile resizes only the box; the glyph keeps the default step's size unless it carries its own `size-7`

whenNotToUse.when: A box that matches one of the built in steps from xs to xl

guidance.bestFor: Outline tiles tinted by hand with fill, border and glyph classes for primary, success, warning and destructive
agentNotes: `success`, `warning` and `destructive-foreground` are ReUI theme colors a stock shadcn theme lacks; the `badge` and `alert` installs add them

whenNotToUse.when: A tone set by one text color class, with fill and border derived from it

guidance.bestFor: Initials and a count in place of a glyph, the first on a raised tile and the second in a round outline with muted text
agentNotes: `AK` holds hard coded sample initials; derive them from each person's name before shipping

whenNotToUse.when: A person's initials standing in for a profile photo that may fail to load

name: c-icon-tile-10
title: List row
label: List Row
description: Icon tile in a list row

guidance.bestFor: A small raised tile in the media slot of an outlined Item row, beside a file title and an updated by line

name: c-icon-tile-11
title: Feature card
label: Feature Card
description: Icon tile in a feature card

guidance.bestFor: A large raised tile heading a Frame panel, stacked over a feature title and one sentence of copy
agentNotes: The feature title is a fixed `h3`; set the heading level to fit the outline of the page it lands on

name: c-icon-tile-12
title: Empty state
label: Empty State
description: Icon tile in an empty state

guidance.bestFor: The largest tile in its nested card surface as the media of an Empty header, above a no files title and hint
agentNotes: Leave `EmptyMedia` on its default variant; its icon variant is a fixed muted box smaller than this xl tile

whenNotToUse.when: A layered isometric drawing as the focal art of a first run screen

guidance.bestFor: A raised tile rendered as a link with its own accessible name, a hover fill and a keyboard focus ring
agentNotes: Composed through `render` on the base twin and `asChild` around the anchor on the radix twin; neither prop works in the other twin
`href` is a hash placeholder; point it at your settings route and keep the `aria-label` in step with it

guidance.bestFor: A raised globe tile with a green dot pinned to its top end corner, cut out by a page colored ring
agentNotes: The wrapper `span` sets `aria-hidden`, so the dot's status is never announced; state it in text beside the tile
The dot's `bg-success` needs the ReUI `success` color, absent from a stock shadcn theme until `badge` or `alert` is installed

guidance.bestFor: Soft tiles retinted through 1 text color class each, from the primary default to the info and status tones
agentNotes: `text-info-foreground` and the other tone classes need ReUI colors a stock shadcn theme lacks, or those tiles turn neutral gray

whenNotToUse.when: A filled tone with a contrasting glyph in place of a tinted ring

guidance.bestFor: Filled tiles that swap the primary fill for an info, success, warning or destructive bg class with a white glyph
agentNotes: Without the ReUI `info`, `success` and `warning` colors, those 3 tiles paint no fill and their `text-white` glyph vanishes on a light page

whenNotToUse.when: A quieter tint where the glyph keeps the tone color on a pale fill

name: c-icon-tile-17
title: Brand colors
label: Brand Colors
description: Elevated tile with a Tailwind color fill

guidance.bestFor: Raised tiles whose fill is swapped for indigo, amber, emerald and rose palette colors while the ring and shadow stay

whenNotToUse.when: Status tones that follow the theme's own colors rather than fixed palette shades
